blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — All public and private schools in Tacurong City, Sultan Kudarat have temporarily shifted to alternative learning modes following the recent deadly shooting at Banga National High School (BNHS) in neighboring South Cotabato. Mayor Lina Montilla ordered the suspension of face-to-face classes at all levels, from preschool to higher education, starting Sept. 21
